description: Consider a school district with a number of neighborhoods, schools, and grades at each school. Each school has a capacity for each grade. In each neighborhood, the student population of each grade is known. The distance of each school from each neighborhood is also known. The goal is to assign all students to schools, while minimizing the total distance traveled by all students.

Capacity.definition: Capacity of school s for grade g

Population.definition: Number of students of grade g in neighborhood n

Distance.definition: Distance from neighborhood n to school s

objective.description: "Minimize the total distance traveled by all students when assigning them to schools"

constraints.description: For each neighborhood n and grade g, the total number of students assigned to all schools must equal the population of grade g in neighborhood n
For each school s and grade g, the total number of students assigned from all neighborhoods must not exceed the capacity of school s for grade g
constraints.formulation: $\\forall s = 1, \\dots, NumSchools,\\; \\forall g = 1, \\dots, NumGrades:\\; \\sum_{n = 1}^{NumNeighborhoods} Assignments[n, s, g] \\leq Capacity[s, g]$

constraints.description: The number of students assigned from neighborhood n to school s for grade g must be a non-negative integer

Assignments.definition: Number of students of grade g from neighborhood n assigned to school s
